description: Avoid single-character variable names — they hurt readability
Cache repeated database lookups inside the request loop
Never interpolate raw user input directly into SQL queries
Nested loops 2 or more deep that call another function are O(N^2) candidates and must be reviewed.
Direct call to built-in abs() or unmetered math is forbidden; use SafeAbs wrapper.
Database queries and I/O operations inside loop iterations cause severe latency compounding.
Never call pickle.loads or eval on raw unverified user data.
